overview_note.text: No progress was made in increasing the motor pool line item budgets within the general fund to reflect the full rate. Current 2026 general fund projections indicate a yearend surplus. The Council could adopt a budget modification to absorb the full rate charges to departments with the Motor Pool revenue used to fund future fleet investment.
